result.instructions: Tools for Nexudus, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which coworkers have a booking for a meeting room tomorrow?"; "Show the coworker profile for jane@example.com and her current plan."; "List the unpaid invoices issued to coworkers this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Nexudus data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nexudus_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nexudus_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nexudus_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. nexudus_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nexudus_list_coworkers
tools.title: List coworkers
tools.description: List coworkers (members and customers) of the Nexudus space, with paging, sorting and an optional full-name filter. Summary records only; use nexudus_get_coworker for every field. Nexudus API: GET /api/spaces/coworkers.

order_by.description: Field to sort by, for example CreatedOn or Name. Check the field names in Nexudus.

updated_from.description: Only records updated on or after this time (yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm).

updated_to.description: Only records updated on or before this time (yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm).

full_name.description: Only coworkers with this full name (exact match).
